furniture.name: Monolith Architectural Sofa
furniture.why: A stark, low-slung sofa with absolute geometric lines. Provides strong orthogonal framing and anchors the room's primary axis.

furniture.name: Sartorial Armchair
furniture.why: High-backed leather lounge chair with strict structural steel legs. Positions the user in an authoritative high-comfort command point.

furniture.name: Boucle Intimate Nest Sofa
furniture.why: Curved, organically shaped L-sofa wrapped in ultra-soft boucle. Subconsciously draws family members inward to a conversational circle.

furniture.name: Textured Cozy Tub Chair
furniture.why: Soft rounded tub armchair with low center of gravity. Provides warm acoustic containment and social comfort.

furniture.name: Deep-Focus Acoustic Wingback
furniture.why: Deeply recessed wingback chair with high acoustic fabric panels to isolate the reader and block background visual distractions.

furniture.name: Minimalist Oak Floating Desk
furniture.why: A clean, wall-mounted cantilever desk with zero leg clutter. Preserves maximum negative space and maintains clinical visual purity.

furniture.name: Kinetic Modular Lounge
furniture.why: A 3-piece modular sectional lounge that can be easily split, nested, or rearranged to transition from relaxation to social workspace.

furniture.name: Glide Height-Adjustable Table
furniture.why: Gas-lift dining and coffee table hybrid on soft casters. Instantly transforms the room from a formal dining area to a standing focus hub.

plants.name: Cast Iron Plant
plants.water: Allow soil to dry out between waterings
plants.why: Extremely robust with dark green, broad architectural leaves. Adds highly structured organic presence to dark corners without creating chaotic visual noise.

plants.name: Parlor Palm
plants.water: Keep soil evenly damp but never soggy
plants.why: Soft, feathery compound leaves that filter light beautifully. Perfect for softening sharp corners and introducing warm, organic shadows to shared social spaces.

plants.name: Boston Fern
plants.why: Cascading lush fronds that create an enclosing green canopy when placed on high shelves, providing sensory relief and a monastic cocoon feel.

plants.name: Areca Palm
plants.water: Water when top 2cm of soil feels dry
plants.why: Fast-growing, dynamic tropical leaves that add movement and creative kinetic energy to flexible spaces.

plants.name: Snake Plant
plants.water: Water only when soil is bone dry
plants.why: Stiff, vertical sword-like leaves that establish strong orthomorphic accents, reinforcing vertical design axes and visual authority.

plants.name: Swiss Cheese Plant
plants.water: Water when top half of soil is dry
plants.why: Dramatic graphic split leaves that act as an organic sculptural focal point, bringing rich tropical complexity and high design energy.
